description: Na₂BH₄O₄Cl crystallizes in the tetragonal P4/nmm space group. Na is bonded to four equivalent O and two equivalent Cl atoms to form NaCl₂O₄ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaCl₂O₄ octahedra, corners with four equivalent BO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with four equivalent NaCl₂O₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 48°. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.48 Å. Both Na-Cl bond lengths are 2.86 Å. B is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form BO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with eight equivalent NaCl₂O₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 54°. All B-O bond lengths are 1.50 Å. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one B, and one H atom. Cl is bonded to four equivalent Na atoms to form distorted corner-sharing ClNa₄ trigonal pyramids.
